response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM Accounts WHERE date_account_opened > '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND date_account_opened < '2015-02-02 09:47:08';

assumptions.assumption: date_account_opened is stored as text in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format, so string comparison orders values chronologically. NULL values are excluded automatically.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare the dates as actual date-times rather than as text, in case stored values use a different format such as 'T' separators or fractional seconds.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM Accounts WHERE datetime(date_account_opened) > datetime('2011-03-29 15:06:59') AND datetime(date_account_opened) < datetime('2015-02-02 09:47:08');
